item.title: visualstudio: What Would You Build in Azure If You Didn’t Have to Ask for a Budget First?
item.description:
The post says eligible Visual Studio subscribers may already have access to a personal Azure sandbox, making it easier to try .NET apps, serverless, containers, proofs of concept, or unfamiliar Azure services without requesting a budget first.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: github: Enterprise-managed sandbox in Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
Copilot for JetBrains now supports enterprise-managed sandbox policies, along with cross-file cursor jumps for next edit suggestions, global project context in chat, and enterprise policy diagnostics. The update also adds a new terminal Copilot connection.

  • Source: GitHub
